WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.status,
        AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining,
        AVG(1.0 * (b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status
)
SELECT
    status,
    AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining,
    AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS avg_overspend_rate,
    AVG(avg_remaining) / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM event_averages), 0) AS remaining_ratio_to_overall_avg
FROM event_averages
GROUP BY status;
